name: mybatis-lint
description: Static analysis diagnostics for MyBatis mapper XML files.

mybatisLint.analyzerJarPath.description: Path to the mybatis-lint analyzer jar. Leave empty to use the jar bundled with the extension.

mybatisLint.runOnSave.description: Check the workspace again whenever a mapper XML or Java file is saved.

mybatisLint.exclude.markdownDescription: Folders or files to skip, as globs relative to the workspace folder (for example `docker` or `modules/*/generated`). A pattern without `/` matches a folder or file name at any depth. Folders that cannot be read are always skipped.

mybatisLint.disabledRules.markdownDescription: Rules whose problems are not reported, for example `unknown-select-alias` (the `mybatis-lint/` prefix is optional). To silence a single place instead, put `mybatis-lint-disable-next-line <rule>` in a comment on the line above it.

mybatisLint.codeLens.description: Show how many places use each <sql> and <resultMap>, and links between statements and Java mapper methods, above their definitions.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language.
mybatisLint.previewLanguage.description: Language of the SQL preview panel.

mybatisLint.keepAnalyzerRunning.description: Keep the analyzer running between checks, so checks after the first are faster. It re-reads only the files that changed. Turn off to start the analyzer for every check.

enumDescriptions: Show the column names at the end of every line that has values.
Show it only where the value's own name differs from the column, such as #{amount} for NOTE.
mybatisLint.insertColumnHints.markdownDescription: Show, in `<insert>` statements, which `INSERT INTO t (...)` column each `VALUES (...)` value or `SELECT` item goes to, as faint text at the end of its line. The names are lined up within each statement.

mybatisLint.javaPath.description: Path to the Java executable used to run the analyzer. Leave empty to use the Java runtime bundled with the extension.
